NOTE: BBC (Faisal Islam, 20 Jul) — Burnham said Tuesday's cost-of-living support would be "paid for" = tax rise or spending cut. No 10: Burnham and Healey "have the same outlook" on economic stability, fiscal rules, reindustrialisation, devolution. Healey "quickly has to deliver a funded cost of living policy." Unfreezing income tax thresholds (currently basic £12,570, higher £50,271) floated by unions — would cost at least £4bn depending on inflation; adds to list of net-spending policies raising questions about tax rises/borrowing. Burnham funded rough-sleeping pledge from within housing budget.
